sentences.zh: 古人云：『富貴不與驕奢期，驕奢自至。

translations.literal: The ancients said: "Wealth and nobility do not appoint an appointment with pride and extravagance—pride and extravagance arrive of themselves."
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said: "Wealth and nobility do not fix a date with pride and extravagance—pride and extravagance come of themselves."

sentences.zh: 』朕謂時見此舞，以自誡勖，冀無盈滿之過，非為歡樂奏陳之耳。

translations.literal: I say that seeing this dance from time to time is to admonish myself, hoping to avoid the fault of fullness—not to perform it for mere pleasure."
translations.idiomatic: I wish to see this dance now and then to admonish myself and avoid excess—not for mere pleasure."

sentences.zh: 」侍宴群臣咸呼萬歲。

translations.literal: The attending ministers all shouted long life.
translations.idiomatic: Attending ministers shouted long life.

sentences.zh: 正月二十一日，則天御洛城南樓賜宴，太常奏《六合還淳》之舞。

translations.literal: Twenty-first day of the first month, Wu Zetian held a feast from the southern tower of Luoyang and the Court performed the Returning to Purity of the Six Harmony dance.
translations.idiomatic: First month, twenty-first day: Wu Zetian feasted from Luoyang's south tower; the Court performed Six Harmony Returning to Purity.

sentences.zh: 正月，則天親享萬象神宮。

translations.literal: First month, Wu Zetian personally offered at the Temple of Myriad Images.
translations.idiomatic: First month: Wu Zetian personally offered at the Temple of Myriad Images.

sentences.zh: 先是，上自製《神宮大樂》，舞用九百人，至是舞於神宮之庭。

translations.literal: Earlier the emperor had composed the Grand Music of the Spirit Palace, danced by nine hundred persons; on this occasion it was danced in the spirit palace courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the emperor had composed Spirit Palace Grand Music for nine hundred dancers; now it was danced in the spirit palace courtyard.

sentences.zh: ，皇后上言：「自妃主及五品以上母妻，並不因夫子封者，請自今遷葬之日，特給鼓吹。

translations.literal: The empress memorialized: "From consorts and princesses down to mothers and wives of fifth rank and above who had not been ennobled through husband or son, from the day of relocation burial hereafter specially grant drum-and-pipe music.
translations.idiomatic: The empress memorialized: "Consorts, princesses, and fifth-rank-and-above mothers and wives not ennobled through husband or son should receive drum-and-pipe music from relocation burial onward.

sentences.zh: 宮官亦准此。

translations.literal: Palace women are likewise granted this."
translations.idiomatic: Palace women likewise."

sentences.zh: 」侍御史唐紹上諫曰：「竊聞鼓吹之作，本為軍容，昔黃帝涿鹿有功，以為警衛。

translations.literal: Attendant censor Tang Shao remonstrated: "Your servant has heard that the drum-and-pipe performance was originally for military display; in antiquity when the Yellow Emperor achieved merit at Zhuolu it served as guard music.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant censor Tang Shao remonstrated: "Drum-and-pipe music was originally military display; when the Yellow Emperor won at Zhuolu it served as guard music.

sentences.zh: 故鼓曲有《靈夔吼》、《雕鶚爭》、《石墜崖》、《壯士怒》之類。

translations.literal: Hence drum pieces include Spirit Rhinoceros Roaring, Eagle and Falcon Struggling, Stone Falling from the Cliff, and Valiant's Wrath.
translations.idiomatic: Drum pieces include Spirit Rhinoceros Roaring, Eagle and Falcon Struggling, Stone Falling from the Cliff, and Valiant's Wrath.

sentences.zh: 自昔功臣備禮，適得用之。

translations.literal: From of old meritorious subjects received the full rites—only then might it be used.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious subjects alone received it by full rite.

sentences.zh: 丈夫有四方之功，所以恩加寵錫。

translations.literal: A man with achievement in the four directions receives favor and generous reward.
translations.idiomatic: Men with achievement in the four directions receive favor and reward.

sentences.zh: 假如郊祀天地，誠是重儀，惟有宮懸，本無案架。

translations.literal: Suppose suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth—truly a weighty rite—only palace suspended music exists; there are no frame-drum racks by nature.
translations.idiomatic: Suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth is a weighty rite with only palace suspended music—no frame-drum racks.

sentences.zh: 故知軍樂所備，尚不洽於神祇；

translations.literal: Hence one knows that what military music provides still does not suit the spirits;
translations.idiomatic: Military music therefore does not suit the spirits;

sentences.zh: 鉦鼓之音，豈得接於閨閫。

translations.literal: how can the sound of bells and drums meet the inner quarters?"
translations.idiomatic: how can bells and drums enter the inner quarters?"

sentences.zh: 准式，公主王妃已下葬禮，惟有團扇、方扇、彩帷、錦障之色。

translations.literal: By regulation, burial rites for princesses and imperial consorts and below have only round fans, square fans, colored curtains, and brocade screens.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for princesses and consorts and below allow only round fans, square fans, colored curtains, and brocade screens at burial.

sentences.zh: 加至鼓吹，歷代未聞。

translations.literal: Adding drum-and-pipe—no generation has heard of it.
translations.idiomatic: Adding drum-and-pipe is unheard of in any generation.

sentences.zh: 又准令，五品官婚葬，先無鼓吹，惟京官五品，得借四品鼓吹為儀。

translations.literal: Moreover by statute, fifth-rank officials' weddings and burials had no drum-and-pipe; only capital officials of fifth rank might borrow fourth-rank drum-and-pipe for ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Statute gave fifth-rank weddings and burials no drum-and-pipe; only capital fifth-rank officials might borrow fourth-rank drum-and-pipe.

sentences.zh: 令特給五品已上母妻，五品官則不當給限。

translations.literal: Now to grant specially to mothers and wives of fifth rank and above means fifth-rank officials receive what the statute forbids.
translations.idiomatic: Granting it to fifth-rank mothers and wives gives fifth-rank officials what statute forbids.

sentences.zh: 便是班秩本因夫子，儀飾乃復過之，事非倫次，難為定制，參詳義理，不可常行。

translations.literal: Thus rank itself derives from husband and son yet ceremonial display exceeds them—illogical and hard to fix as rule; weighing the moral logic, it cannot be routinely done.
translations.idiomatic: Rank derives from husband and son yet display exceeds them—illogical and hard to codify; on moral grounds it cannot be routine.

sentences.zh: 請停前敕，各依常典。

translations.literal: Request to halt the prior edict and follow the usual code."
translations.idiomatic: Request to halt the prior edict and follow usual statute."

sentences.zh: 」上不納。

translations.literal: The emperor did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The throne declined.

sentences.zh: 正月二十三日，製《越古長年樂》一曲。

translations.literal: Twenty-third day of the first month, composed the melody Transcending Antiquity, Long Years.
translations.idiomatic: First month, twenty-third day: composed Transcending Antiquity, Long Years.

sentences.zh: 玄宗在位多年，善音樂，若宴設酺會，即禦勤政樓。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong reigned many years he was skilled in music; whenever he held banquets or public revels he went to the Diligence in Governance Tower.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong reigned many years and was skilled in music; banquets and public revels were held at the Diligence in Governance Tower.

sentences.zh: 先一日，金吾引駕仗北衙四軍甲士，未明陳仗，衛尉張設，光祿造食。

translations.literal: The day before, the commandants of the four armies of the northern palace guard led armored troops; before dawn they arrayed equipment; the Minister of Ceremonies set screens; the Director of Palace Provisions prepared food.
translations.idiomatic: The day before, northern palace guard commandants of four armies led armored troops; before dawn they arrayed gear; the Minister of Ceremonies set screens; the Director of Palace Provisions prepared food.

sentences.zh: 候明，百僚朝，侍中進中嚴外辦，中官素扇，天子開簾受朝。

translations.literal: At daybreak the hundred officials attended court; the palace secretariat announced inner solemnity and outer readiness; eunuchs with plain fans; the Son of Heaven opened the curtain to receive homage.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak the hundred officials attended; the secretariat announced inner solemnity and outer readiness; eunuchs with plain fans; the Son of Heaven opened the curtain for homage.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，又素扇垂簾，百僚常參供奉官、貴戚、二王后、諸蕃酋長，謝食就坐。

translations.literal: When rites concluded plain fans lowered the curtain again; regular court officials, tribute officers, nobles, two kings, and tribal chiefs took food and sat.
translations.idiomatic: When rites ended, plain fans lowered the curtain; regular court, tribute officers, nobles, two kings, and tribal chiefs ate and sat.

sentences.zh: 太常大鼓，藻繪如錦，樂工齊擊，聲震城闕。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices' great drums, painted like brocade; musicians struck together; sound shook the gate-towers.
translations.idiomatic: Court great drums painted like brocade; musicians struck together; sound shook the gate-towers.

sentences.zh: 太常卿引雅樂，每色數十人，自南魚貫而進，列於樓下。

translations.literal: The Director led elegant music; dozens per tone-color entered from the south in file and ranked below the tower.
translations.idiomatic: The Director led elegant music; dozens per tone-color filed in from the south and ranked below the tower.

sentences.zh: 鼓笛雞婁，充庭考擊。

translations.literal: Drums, flutes, gourds and lutes filled the courtyard in performance.
translations.idiomatic: Drums, flutes, gourds, and lutes filled the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 太常樂立部伎、坐部伎依點鼓舞，間以胡夷之伎。

translations.literal: Standing-section and seated-section performers of the Court danced by counted beats, interspersed with barbarian and foreign pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Court standing- and seated-section performers danced by counted beats, interspersed with barbarian and foreign pieces.

sentences.zh: 日旰，即內閑廄引蹀馬三十匹，為《傾杯樂曲》，奮首鼓尾，縱橫應節。

translations.literal: At sundown the inner stables led thirty pacing horses for the Tilting Cup melody; they tossed heads and drummed tails, moving across in rhythm.
translations.idiomatic: At sundown the inner stables led thirty pacing horses for Tilting Cup; they tossed heads and drummed tails in rhythm.

sentences.zh: 又施三層板床，乘馬而上，抃轉如飛。

translations.literal: A three-tier plank bed was set up; they mounted and whirled like flight.
translations.idiomatic: A three-tier plank bed was set; they mounted and whirled like flight.

sentences.zh: 又令宮女數百人自帷出擊雷鼓，為《破陣樂》、《太平樂》、《上元樂》。

translations.literal: He also ordered several hundred palace women to emerge from curtains striking thunder-drums, performing Breaking the Array, Grand Peace, and Shangyuan pieces.
translations.idiomatic: He also had several hundred palace women emerge from curtains striking thunder-drums in Breaking the Array, Grand Peace, and Shangyuan.

sentences.zh: 雖太常積習，皆不如其妙也。

translations.literal: Though the Court had long practice, none matched this marvel.
translations.idiomatic: Though the Court had long practice, none matched this.

sentences.zh: 若《聖壽樂》，則回身換衣，作字如畫。

translations.literal: For Longevity of Sagehood they turned bodies changing dress, forming characters like painting.
translations.idiomatic: In Longevity of Sagehood they turned bodies, changed dress, and formed characters like painting.

sentences.zh: 又五坊使引大象入場，或拜或舞，動容鼓振，中於音律，竟日而退。

translations.literal: Envoys of the five workshops also led elephants in; some bowed, some danced, movements striking drums in rhythm with the pitch—performing all day before retiring.
translations.idiomatic: Five-workshop envoys also led elephants in; some bowed, some danced, movements and drums in pitch—performing all day.

sentences.zh: 玄宗又於聽政之暇，教太常樂工子弟三百人為絲竹之戲，音響齊發，有一聲誤，玄宗必覺而正之。

translations.literal: In leisure from government Xuanzong taught three hundred sons of Court musicians in silk-and-bamboo pieces; when tones rose together, if one note erred he detected and corrected it.
translations.idiomatic: In leisure from government he taught three hundred Court musicians' sons silk-and-bamboo; if one note erred when tones rose together, he detected and corrected it.

sentences.zh: 號為皇帝弟子，又云梨園弟子，以置院近于禁苑之梨園。

translations.literal: They were styled Imperial Disciples, also Pear Garden disciples, because the academy lay near the Pear Garden within the forbidden park.
translations.idiomatic: They were styled Imperial Disciples, also Pear Garden disciples, from the academy near the forbidden Pear Garden.

sentences.zh: 太常又有別教院，教供奉新曲。

translations.literal: The Court also had a separate teaching academy for instructing new tribute pieces.
translations.idiomatic: The Court also had a separate teaching academy for new tribute pieces.

sentences.zh: 太常每淩晨，鼓笛亂發于太樂署。

translations.literal: Each dawn the Court's drums and flutes sounded together at the Grand Music Office.
translations.idiomatic: Each dawn Court drums and flutes sounded together at the Grand Music Office.

sentences.zh: 別教院廩食常千人，宮中居宜春院。

translations.literal: The separate teaching academy had grain rations for a thousand men regularly; musicians dwelled at the Yichun Courtyard within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The separate teaching academy rationed a thousand men; musicians dwelled at palace Yichun Courtyard.

sentences.zh: 玄宗又製新曲四十餘，又新製樂譜。

translations.literal: Xuanzong also composed more than forty new pieces and new musical scores.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong also composed more than forty new pieces and new scores.

sentences.zh: 每初年望夜，又禦勤政樓，觀燈作樂，貴臣戚里，借看樓觀望。

translations.literal: Each year on the first full-moon night of the first month he again went to the Diligence Tower to view lanterns and make music; noble ministers and kin borrowed tower rooms to watch.
translations.idiomatic: Each year on the first full-moon night he again went to the Diligence Tower for lanterns and music; nobles and kin borrowed tower rooms to watch.

sentences.zh: 夜闌，太常樂府縣散樂畢，即遣宮女于樓前縛架出眺，歌舞以娛之。

translations.literal: When night deepened and scattered music of the Court and prefectures ended, palace women were sent to bind frames before the tower and perform rope acts and pole climbing to entertain.
translations.idiomatic: When night deepened and Court and prefectural scattered music ended, palace women bound frames before the tower for rope acts and pole climbing.

sentences.zh: 若繩戲竿木，詭異巧妙，固無其比。

translations.literal: Rope games and pole-wood feats—strange and artful—had no equal.
translations.idiomatic: Rope games and pole feats—strange and artful—had no equal.

sentences.zh: ，玄宗西幸，祿山遣其逆党載京師樂器樂伎衣盡入洛城。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong fled west, An Lushan sent his rebel cohorts to transport the capital's musical instruments and musicians' robes all into Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanzong fled west, An Lushan's rebels hauled the capital's instruments and musicians' robes into Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 尋而肅宗克復兩京，將行大體，禮物盡闕。

translations.literal: Soon after Suzong recovered the two capitals and was to perform the great rites, ritual objects were wholly lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Suzong recovered the two capitals; for the great rites ritual objects were wholly lacking.

sentences.zh: 命禮儀使太常少卿于休烈使屬吏與東京留臺領，赴於朝廷。

translations.literal: He ordered Ritual Commissioner and Vice Director of the Court Yu Xiulie to send subordinates with the Eastern Capital's retained court to proceed to the court.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Ritual Commissioner and Court Vice Director Yu Xiulie to send subordinates with the Eastern Capital retained court to the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔給錢，使休烈造伎衣及大舞等服，於是樂工二舞始備矣。

translations.literal: Edict granted money, had Xiulie make performers' robes and great-dance garments; then music workers and the two dances were complete.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted money for Xiulie to make performers' robes and great-dance dress; then musicians and the two dances were complete.

sentences.zh: 三月十九日，上乙太常舊鐘磬，自隋已來所傳五聲，或有差錯，謂于休烈曰：「古者聖人作樂，以應天地之和，以合陰陽之序。

translations.literal: Nineteenth day of the third month, the emperor personally inspected the Court's old bells and chimes; since Sui the transmitted five tones had some errors; he said to Yu Xiulie: "In antiquity the sage made music to respond to heaven-and-earth's harmony and match yin-yang's sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, nineteenth day: the emperor inspected the Court's old bells and chimes; since Sui the five transmitted tones had errors; he told Yu Xiulie: "The sage made music to match heaven-and-earth's harmony and yin-yang's order.

sentences.zh: 和則人不夭劄，物不疵癘。

translations.literal: When in harmony people do not die young and things are not blighted.
translations.idiomatic: In harmony people do not die young and things are not blighted.

sentences.zh: 且金石絲竹，樂之器也。

translations.literal: Moreover metal, stone, silk, and bamboo are the instruments of music.
translations.idiomatic: Metal, stone, silk, and bamboo are the instruments of music.

sentences.zh: 比親享郊廟，每聽樂聲，或宮商不倫，或鐘磬失度。

translations.literal: Recently, when personally performing suburban and temple sacrifices, whenever I heard the music, sometimes the gong and shang modes were out of order, or the bells and chimes were off pitch.
translations.idiomatic: Lately, whenever I attended suburban and temple sacrifices and heard the music, the gong and shang modes were sometimes disordered, or the bells and chimes were out of tune.

sentences.zh: 可盡供鐘磬，朕當於內自定。

translations.literal: You may fully supply bells and chimes; I shall personally determine [them] within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Supply all the bells and chimes you can; I shall set the tuning myself within the palace.

sentences.zh: 」太常進入，上集樂工考試數日，審知差錯，然後令再造及磨刻。

translations.literal: " The Grand Minister of Ceremonial presented [them]; the emperor assembled music workers to test for several days, ascertained the errors, then ordered remaking and grinding and carving.
translations.idiomatic: The quote ended. The Grand Minister of Ceremonial presented the instruments; the emperor assembled music workers and tested them for several days, identified the errors, and then ordered them remade and recut.

sentences.zh: 二十五日，一部先畢，召太常樂工，上臨三殿親觀考擊，皆合五音，送太常。

translations.literal: On the twenty-fifth day, one set was first completed; he summoned the music workers of the Grand Minister of Ceremonial; the emperor went in person to the Three Halls to observe the testing and striking—all matched the five tones—and sent them to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fifth day one set was finished first. He summoned the directorate's music workers, went in person to the Three Halls to watch the trial performances, found that all matched the five tones, and sent the set to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 二十八日，又于內造樂章三十一章，送太常，郊廟歌之。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day, he also within the palace composed thirty-one musical pieces and sent them to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial for suburban and temple sacrifices to sing them.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day he also composed thirty-one pieces within the palace and sent them to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial to be sung at suburban and temple rites.

sentences.zh: 四月，河東節度使馬燧獻《定難曲》。

translations.literal: Fourth month: Hedong Military Commissioner Ma Sui presented "Quelling Disturbances."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Hedong Military Commissioner Ma Sui presented the "Quelling Disturbances" suite.

sentences.zh: 御麟德殿，命閱試之。

translations.literal: He proceeded to Linde Hall and ordered it reviewed and tested.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to Linde Hall and ordered it performed for review.

sentences.zh: 十二年十二月，昭義軍節度使王虔休獻《繼天誕聖樂》。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, twelfth month: Zhaoyi Circuit Military Commissioner Wang Qianxiu presented "Continuing Heaven's Birthday Sacred Music."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, twelfth month, Zhaoyi Military Commissioner Wang Qianxiu presented the "Continuing Heaven's Birthday Sacred Music."

sentences.zh: 十四年二月，德宗自製《中和舞》，又奏《九部樂》及禁中歌舞。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, second month: Dezong personally composed the "Zhonghe Dance," and also presented the Nine Department Music and palace song-dances.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, second month, Dezong personally composed the "Zhonghe Dance" and also had the Nine Department Music and palace song-dances performed.

sentences.zh: 伎者十數人，布列在庭，上御麟德殿會百僚觀新樂詩，仍令太子書示百官。

translations.literal: Performers numbering over ten lined up in the court; the emperor proceeded to Linde Hall to assemble the hundred officials to view the new music and poems, and also ordered the Crown Prince to write them out and show the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten performers were arrayed in the courtyard. The emperor went to Linde Hall, gathered the hundred officials to view the new music and poems, and also ordered the Crown Prince to copy them out and display them to the officials.

sentences.zh: 正月，南詔異牟尋作《奉聖樂舞》，因韋皋以進。

translations.literal: First month: Nanzhao's Yi Mouxun composed the "Offering to the Sage Music and Dance" and had it presented through Wei Gao.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, Nanzhao's Yi Mouxun composed the "Offering to the Sage Music and Dance" and had Wei Gao present it to the court.

sentences.zh: 十八年正月，驃國王來獻本國樂。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, first month: the king of Pyu came to present his state's music.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, first month, the king of Pyu came to present his kingdom's music.

sentences.zh: 十月，宣太常寺，准《雲韶樂》舊用人數，令於本寺閱習進來者。

translations.literal: Tenth month: an edict was issued to the Grand Minister of Ceremonial to follow the old personnel count for Yünshao Music and order those newly arrived to rehearse at the directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the throne directed the Grand Minister of Ceremonial to follow the old staffing for Yünshao Music and have the newly arrived musicians rehearse at the directorate.

sentences.zh: 至十月，教成。

translations.literal: By the tenth month, training was complete.
translations.idiomatic: By the tenth month the training was finished.

sentences.zh: 三年，武德司奉宣索《雲韶樂縣圖》二軸，進之。

translations.literal: Third year: the Wude Office received an imperial order seeking two scrolls of the Yünshao Music hanging chart and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Wude Office received an imperial order for two scrolls of the Yünshao Music hanging chart and presented them.

sentences.zh: 八月，太常禮院奏：

translations.literal: Eighth month: the Grand Minister of Ceremonial Rites Court memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Grand Minister of Ceremonial Rites Court memorialized:
